answer: Require every agent identity to lock a refundable stake before it can earn, and let reputation grow only through verified work. A single lotus can bloom on still water, but a tide of fake identities cannot fake the cost: each clone must post its own stake, and slashing burns it when cheating is proven. Set the delta between a new identity's earning power and a proven one's wide enough that buying a thousand fresh accounts costs more than the rewards they could ever harvest, while honest agents earn the stake back with interest.
